construct_source: Ideational definition of populism: people-centrism (P), anti-elitism (E), Manichean moral antagonism (M). Sub-frame tags follow alternative-pairs/v3/subframe_anchors.json.
drafting_note: Minimal pairs: each mainstream member keeps the populist member's topic, actors, grammatical person and approximate length, and replaces only the construct-bearing claim. For E the mainstream member is usually a bounded, specific criticism of the same actor, so negative affect is matched rather than contrasted. M contrasts moralized antagonism with ordinary disagreement and is expected to differ in sentiment by construction. Drafted from theory before any step-3 result; no benchmark label was consulted.
